customglint.configuration.outlineRenderS: How sharp the glow outlines are drawn. 1 = full quality. Set to 2 or 3 for a softer outline that runs much faster on low-end machines. Changes apply right away.
customglint.configuration.outlineMaxDist: Farthest distance (in blocks) that glow outlines are drawn. 0 = no limit. Lowering this skips outlines on far-away mobs and items, which means fewer shapes to draw and less GPU work in crowded scenes.
customglint.configuration.outlineMaxEnti: Most entities that can be outlined at the same time. 0 = no limit. Caps the worst case when huge numbers of glowing mobs are packed on screen.
customglint.configuration.entityGlowOutl: Show the glowing outline on mobs and players. Turn off for extra FPS on weak hardware. Glints and glow colors are unaffected.
customglint.configuration.itemGlowOutlin: Show the glowing outline on dropped and held items.
